visualCharacteristics: Vertical list of article rows. Each row has a small thumbnail image on the left and a text column on the right containing a bold title, a short description, and a 'Learn more' link.
contentPattern: One row per article. Each row: cell 1 = thumbnail image, cell 2 = title + description + 'Learn more' link.
usage: Article/experience list, e.g. 'Exceptional experiences with Saudia'.
